verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://developers.kit.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with an agent-oriented index linking markdown pages, and the doc pages are served as .md. Kit also ships a Developer Docs MCP server built so AI coding agents can query its live API reference instead of relying on pasted or hallucinated docs. Missing for 10: no independent or community corroboration of agents successfully using llms.txt or the docs MCP in practice.
